content: {"episode_id":"ep-05049","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the CO-197 denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) on medical necessity grounds; the case lists prior authorization as missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent presyncope and dizziness, with concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology given the patient's history of atrial fibrillation. Continuous ambulatory mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm and rule out high-grade conduction disease or sustained arrhythmia."}
